definitions.explanation: A physical sensation of numbness or pins and needles, often from sitting in one position too long or nerve issues.

examples.japanese: {正座|せいざ}をしていたら{足|あし}に{痺|しび}れがきた。
examples.english: My legs went numb from sitting in seiza.

examples.japanese: {指先|ゆびさき}の{痺|しび}れが{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The numbness in my fingertips continues.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
{痺|しび}れる - to go numb, to feel pins and needles

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{痺|しび}れがくる - to go numb
・{痺|しび}れが{切|き}れる - for numbness to wear off
・{手足|てあし}の{痺|しび}れ - numbness in the limbs

RELATED PHYSICAL SENSATIONS:
・むくみ - swelling
・かゆみ - itchiness
・{凝|こ}り - stiffness

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
{痺|しび}れ can be a symptom of various conditions including poor circulation, nerve compression, or neurological issues. See a doctor if persistent.
